Class Oval

java.lang.Object
shapes.MyShape
shapes.Oval
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class Oval extends MyShape
Oval is a concrete subclass of MyShape representing an oval defined by its bounding rectangle (two corner points). It provides methods to draw the oval, move it, and access its properties.

This class is part of a JavaFX-based shape editor application.

Example usage:


 Point2D topLeft = new Point2D(20, 30);
 Point2D bottomRight = new Point2D(150, 100);
 Oval oval = new Oval(topLeft, bottomRight);
 oval.setColor(Color.BLUE);
 oval.setFilled(true);
 oval.draw(graphicsContext);

    • draw

      public void draw(javafx.scene.canvas.GraphicsContext gc)
      Draws this Oval on the given GraphicsContext. The method draws the bounding box and the oval itself. If MyShape.isFilled() is true, the oval is filled with its color. Otherwise, it is drawn as an outline.
      Specified by:
      draw in class MyShape
      Parameters:
      gc - the GraphicsContext used for drawing
